_comment: Koodikoulu (games/koodikoulu): generated by tools/koodikoulu/gen-voice.ts, same ids as voice/fi.json.

clips.kk_intro: Programming has four important words: memory slot, operator, data structure and function. When you know these four, you can make almost anything!
clips.kk_kesken: The program still has a question mark. Fill it in first.
clips.kk_l1: The robot bakes a cake, but it remembers nothing by itself. It reads everything from memory slots. Put the order into the memory slots and press run.
clips.kk_m_luku: This memory slot is called candles. It holds one number. When you put in a new number, the old one is gone.
clips.kk_m_teksti: A new memory slot! Name holds text, a word. Write the customer's name on the cake.
clips.kk_m_kylla: A new memory slot! Icing only holds yes or no.
clips.kk_m_taas: A new order! Change the memory slots.
clips.kk_m_vaara_kynttilat: The number of candles is wrong. Look at the memory slot candles.
clips.kk_m_vaara_nimi: The cake has the wrong name. Look at the memory slot name.
clips.kk_m_vaara_kuorrute: The icing is wrong. Look at the memory slot icing.
clips.kk_m_valmis: Exactly the cake that was ordered!
clips.kk_m_vihje: The robot only does what the memory slots say. Compare each memory slot with the order.
clips.kk_l2: An operator is a machine that makes a new value out of two values.
clips.kk_o_valitse: Which operator makes the goal out of A and B? Choose and run.
clips.kk_o_aseta: Now the operator is ready. Change memory slot B so that you get the goal.
clips.kk_o_sanat: Plus works for words too: it glues two words together. Tap the words in the right order.
clips.kk_o_vertaa: A comparison operator answers yes or no. The lamp lights up when the answer is yes.
clips.kk_o_sammuta: Now the lamp must stay dark.
clips.kk_o_vertaa_a: The operator is ready. Change number A so the lamp lights up.
clips.kk_o_logiikka: And and or join yes and no answers. And needs both keys. Or is happy with one.
clips.kk_o_vaara: The result is not the goal.
clips.kk_o_ei_voi: This operator does not work for these values.
clips.kk_o_vihje: Try it in your head: what do you get with this operator between A and B?
clips.kk_s_paloauto: Make the word fire engine: palo plus auto.
clips.kk_s_lumiukko: Make the word snowman: lumi plus ukko.
clips.kk_s_lentokone: Make the word aeroplane: lento plus kone.
clips.kk_s_auringonkukka: Make the word sunflower: aurinko plus kukka.
clips.kk_s_kilpikonna: Make the word turtle: kilpi plus konna.
clips.kk_s_vesimeloni: Make the word watermelon: vesi plus meloni.
clips.kk_s_kirjahylly: Make the word bookshelf: kirja plus hylly.
clips.kk_s_mansikkakakku: Make the word strawberry cake: mansikka plus kakku.
clips.kk_l3: A data structure keeps many things. Let's make a layered smoothie: the fruits must go into the cup in the recipe's order, from the bottom up.
clips.kk_d_lista: This is a list. Every place has a number. Tell the robot the numbers of the places in the recipe's order.
clips.kk_d_jono: This is a queue, like the line at a shop. A new one goes to the back, and the one that came first leaves from the front.
clips.kk_d_pino: This is a stack, like a stack of plates. A new one goes on top, and the robot always takes from the top.
clips.kk_d_lokero: These are drawers. Each drawer has a name. Put each animal's favourite food in its drawer. The animals come in any order.
clips.kk_d_vaara: The layers went in another order than the recipe. Look at the order the data structure gives things out.
clips.kk_d_vaara_pino: From a stack, the last one put in comes out first. So put the bottom layer in last.
clips.kk_d_vaara_lokero: Some animal got the wrong food. Look at the names of the drawers.
clips.kk_d_vihje: The arrow shows the next one. Think about which end the data structure gives things out from.
clips.kk_l4: A function is a machine with a recipe. You make the recipe once, and the machine follows it every time it is called.
clips.kk_f_luku: Look at the number each one brings and the number it wants back. Make one recipe that works for everyone.
clips.kk_f_kysy: This function answers yes or no. Make a recipe that says yes to exactly the right numbers.
clips.kk_f_kaksi: Now the recipe has two steps: first one calculation, then another.
clips.kk_f_vaara: The machine got it wrong for someone. The red row shows who.
clips.kk_f_valmis: The function is ready! The same machine works again and again with different numbers.
clips.kk_f_vihje: Look at the first row. What do you do to the number to get the one wanted? Does the same work for the others?
clips.kk_l5: Now we use all four: a list, a memory slot, an operator and a function. Fix the program, and the robot runs it line by line.
clips.kk_k_laske: The program must count how many of these are in the basket.
clips.kk_k_summa: The program must work out what the basket costs. The prices are in the drawers.
clips.kk_k_testi: It works! Let's test it with another basket too.
clips.kk_k_vaara: The result was wrong. Look at how the memory slot changed on each line.
clips.kk_k_vaara_testi: The first basket was right, but the second was not. The program must work for every basket.
clips.kk_k_valmis: The program works! With these four you can make almost anything.
clips.kk_k_vihje: The memory slot starts from some number, and something is done to it every round. Where does counting start, and what is added each time?
